text:
Niru: Heads-up: I have two spare tickets to the Stand-Up Lab comedy night this Friday (SF) — can't make it. Also clearing out my old 27" IPS monitor (2560x1440, DisplayPort + USB hub). Free to pick up from SF office (left bench) or I can drop at mailroom. First come first served.

Sam K: Interested in the monitor if it's still around. Any dead pixels? Weight?

Niru: @Sam K no dead pixels, light bezel scuff on bottom right. It's ~12lbs. I'll bring the weight spec if you want to double-check.

Priya (she/her): Are the tix transferable? I might go with @Diego.

Niru: @Priya yes, organizer said ok to transfer. I can Venmo same-day for the transfer fee ($12).

Alex - Facilities: FYI if someone needs help moving the monitor we have a dolly in storage A and I can meet 6pm. It's heavy-ish for one person.

Diego: I'll take one ticket if @Priya wants the second. Can pick up Thurs morning.

Sam K: I can do Thursday as well for the monitor. Can leave it on the left bench with a sticky note "Sam"?

Niru: @Sam K @Diego @Priya locking it in: tickets -> @Priya and @Diego, monitor -> @Sam K. I'll leave the monitor on the left bench with a Post-it and send a DM with pickup notes.

Diego: Awesome, thanks! I'll Venmo the $12 transfer to @Niru.

Sam K: Sweet. If anyone wants the DP cable, I also have a spare I can toss in.

remind-bot: Reminder set — "Niru: leave monitor on left bench for Sam" at 2026-05-14 08:00.

Niru: Updated: monitor left on left bench labeled "Sam K". Tickets transferred to @Priya and @Diego. Thanks!
